summary: Semicircular gauge of green, amber and red cells with a sprung pointer; the zone word rolls when the value crosses a threshold.

attributes.name: zones
attributes.description: Two thresholds in value units, comma-separated: `Elevated` from the first, `Critical` from the second. A missing or invalid threshold uses 60 or 85. Observed.

attributes.name: decimals
attributes.description: Decimal places in the displayed number. Observed.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text under the gauge and the start of the `aria-label`. Observed.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Text after the number. An empty value hides it. Observed.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Clamped value. Setting it writes the attribute.

properties.name: frac
properties.description: Position of the value in the range, 0 to 1.

properties.name: zones
properties.description: The two thresholds as fractions of the range, 0 to 1.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="meter"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow` and an `aria-label` such as `Rate limit: 72%, Elevated`.
The number and zone word are plain text; there is no live region.
motion: With reduced motion the pointer jumps without the spring, the shimmer and the critical pulse are off, and the number and zone word swap without rolling.
notes: All attributes are observed; a change animates the pointer to the new position.

data.note: Set `value` (with `min`, `max` and `zones`). Without it the gauge shows a demo value.
